text:
incidents-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT DETECTED: GPU pool us-west1-production saturated. Autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (API 503). Queue length: 3k -> 12k in ~8m. 429 throttles up 8.3%. Affected: hosted inference routes (/v1/generate). Paging on-call rotation now.

carla (oncall): I'm on pager. Starting triage. Noted spike at 12:29 UTC. Any recent infra/runtime changes?

dmitri (infra): We pushed a config change at 12:25 UTC — PR #5234 for continuous-batcher: BATCH_HOLD_MS increased from 8->50 and prefix cache warmup disabled (to test mem usage). Rollout finished 12:27.

alice (runtime): That matches. Increasing BATCH_HOLD_MS means requests wait longer to fill batches — normally improves throughput but if prefix cache miss rate rises, it can blow up queueing and increase GPU occupancy. Our metrics show prefix_cache_miss_rate jumped after the change.

ben (eng-ml): Also seeing a burst of many short prompts from a customer causing many incomplete batches. Combined with higher hold_ms it's turning into long waits — we end up with fewer, larger batches that block GPUs while they wait for prefix keys to be computed, then miss leading to wasted work.

carla (oncall): Customer-impact assessment: hosted customers -> elevated p95 latencies and 500/429s. Early signal: 7 paying customers reported errors via alerts, 2 timeouts escalated. Marking impact: partial outage for high-concurrency hosted endpoints.

sre-rotation: Assigning infra + runtime. Carla -> lead, Dmitri -> infra rollback, Alice -> runtime config/observability.

carla (oncall): Immediate mitigation options? Can we revert PR or tweak config to reduce BATCH_HOLD_MS? Want to avoid full cluster restarts if possible.

dmitri (infra): Rolling back PR #5234 now. Doing a targeted rollback for continuous-batcher deployment to previous revision. Command:```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/continuous-batcher --to-revision=22
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/continuous-batcher BATCH_HOLD_MS=8 PREFIX_CACHE_WARMUP=true
```

alice (runtime): Also flipping prefix cache ttl back to 600s (it was set to 0 in that change). Command to patch configmap:```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap inference-config --type=json -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/data/PREFIX_CACHE_TTL","value":"600"} ]'
```

incidents-bot: action taken: rollout undo started at 12:45 UTC. Noted autoscaler errors dropping from 503 to fewer. Monitoring for queue/backpressure.

ben (eng-ml): While rollback completes, we can also temporarily reduce per-route concurrency by applying per-route throttles to big customers (rate-limit header) to reduce pressure on the autoscaler. Suggest applying a soft limit: 50 req/s per-tenant for the next 30m.

carla (oncall): Applying soft throttles to top-5 noisy tenants. Command:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","tenant_overrides":[{"tenant":"big-corp","rate_limit":50}]}
```

~12:55 UTC — metrics snippet from infra:```text
queue_length: 12134
gpu_util: 99%
autoscaler_errors: API 503 x37
prefix_cache_miss_rate: 82%
p95_token_latency: 18.2s
429_rate: 8.3%
```

~13:05 UTC — dmitri: Rollout undo completed for continuous-batcher (revision 22). New env BATCH_HOLD_MS=8 and PREFIX_CACHE_WARMUP=true applied. Watching for recovery.

~13:12 UTC — incidents-bot: queue_length falling -> 1.9k. p95 latency trending down to 3.2s. 429s decreasing.

alice (runtime): Observability note: we saw batch size distribution change dramatically after the faulty change: median batch size dropped (packing worse) then jumped to huge sizes with very long wait times. Restoring previous hold_ms returns to expected packing behavior. We'll add a guard in the config validation to prevent >20ms BATCH_HOLD_MS on routes that have high short-prompt ratio.

ben (eng-ml): Confirmed customer reports now down to only background notifications. No escalations in support channel.

carla (oncall): Handoff: my shift ends in 25m, handing incident ownership to alice for postmortem and customer impact calc. Alice: can you gather exact list of affected tenants and per-tenant error counts?

alice (runtime): On it. I will pull logs and create a dedicated ticket with timeline, root cause (PR #5234), mitigation steps, and a follow-up action list: add config gating, improve canary checks for prefix cache miss regression, add autoscaler api error alert.

sre-rotation: Please also include a runbook update: block large BATCH_HOLD_MS changes without canary traffic test and alert on prefix_cache_miss_rate > 10% relative increase.

~13:45 UTC — incidents-bot: key metrics stabilized. queue_length: 420, gpu_util: 72%, 429_rate: 0.4%. Marking incident as mitigated.

carla (oncall): Declaring incident mitigated at 13:46 UTC. Severity: SEV2. Postmortem owner: alice. Action items assigned to dmitri (rollout guard), alice (postmortem + customer impact), ben (packer heuristics), runtime team (add unit/integration canary to catch prefix-cache regressions).

alice (runtime): Will open a postmortem doc and ping infra+ml for root-cause verification. Also will draft customer-facing summary for support to send to affected tenants.

carla (oncall): Thanks team. Handing off cleanly and going off rotation. :thumbsup:

sre-rotation: Incident closed (mitigated) 14:02 UTC. Follow-ups must be tracked in ticket INF-1749.

incidents-bot: Incident thread archived to incidents log.
